children: Retension Pharmaceuticals, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on hypertension, filed a final prospectus for its initial public offering. The company’s common stock will trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker RTSN at $12.00 per share. The IPO comprises 3,750,000 shares, raising gross proceeds of $45 million.

Retension Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing RTN-001, a next‑generation, once‑daily, oral PDE‑5 inhibitor designed to enhance nitric oxide–cGMP signaling to lower blood pressure. Unlike first‑generation PDE‑5 inhibitors, RTN‑001 was engineered for improved bioavailability and distribution to cardiovascular smooth muscle, aiming to deliver sustained reductions in both peripheral and central blood pressure with a modified‑release formulation.

The company is advancing RTN‑001 for patients with uncontrolled and resistant hypertension, populations that remain inadequately served despite widespread availability of existing antihypertensives. RTN‑001 has been evaluated across nine completed clinical studies (including two Phase 2 pilot trials) with 243 participants, demonstrating clinically meaningful placebo‑adjusted blood pressure reductions and a tolerability profile consistent with the PDE‑5 class. A randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled Phase 2b dose‑ranging trial in uncontrolled hypertension is ongoing, with initial data expected in the first half of 2027.
: An estimated 1.4 billion adults with hypertension globally and ~120 million U.S. adults
: Lower treatment targets and unmet control rates expand candidate pools for new therapies
: Focus on nitric oxide–cGMP pathway with a next-generation PDE-5 inhibitor targeting uncontrolled and resistant hypertension
: Multiple generic antihypertensives; indirect competition from classes such as ACE inhibitors, ARBs, calcium channel blockers, diuretics, beta blockers, MRAs
: FDA guidance recognizes blood pressure reduction as an approvable surrogate endpoint, often reducing need for pre‑approval outcomes trials
: Pre-commercial; no product revenue to date
: Approximately 31 U.S. clinical sites in the ongoing Phase 2b trial
: United States clinical operations; prior trials conducted in the UK and Germany
: Exclusive sublicense for RTN‑001 via Redux/Kadmon; third‑party CMOs and CROs for manufacturing and trials

: 9 completed clinical trials; 243 participants dosed historically; ~40% Phase 2b enrollment as of September 11, 2026; initial Phase 2b data expected H1 2027; crystalline polymorph patent protection expected through at least 2044
: -$7.8 million (loss from operations, six months ended June 30, 2026)
, Chief Executive Officer - Biopharma executive and dealmaker; previously led asset licensing and development initiatives at Nano Terra and affiliates.
, Chief Financial Officer - Biopharma finance and IR leader with roles at Ventyx, Allakos, NGM Biopharmaceuticals, and Esperion; former biotech equity research analyst.
, Chief Scientific Officer - Drug discovery leader; previously CSO at Surface Logix where RTN‑001 originated; senior R&D roles at Bayer and Pfizer.
, Chief Medical Officer - Clinical development executive with hypertension and cardiovascular experience at Mineralys, Sanofi‑Genzyme, Baxalta/Shire, and others.
, Chief Operating Officer - Development operations and portfolio leader with experience at Regeneron, Cellectis, and Volastra across oncology and cardiometabolic programs.
, Chairman of the Board - Former pharma R&D head (Bayer, Pfizer) and biotech CEO; extensive governance and transaction experience.
, Director - Veteran biotech investor and former Wall Street analyst; multiple public company directorships.
, Director - Life sciences executive and director; former CEO of NEOMED Institute; extensive board experience.
: Leerink Partners, Guggenheim Securities, Oppenheimer & Co., Titan Partners
: Complete the Phase 2b trial of RTN-001 in uncontrolled hypertension, prepare/support and advance a planned Phase 3, and for general corporate purposes.
